test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Seventy-First Amendment to the Indian Constitution included Konkani, Manipuri, and Nepali languages in the _____ Schedule.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eighth.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** 71st Amendment**, **enacted in 1992,** added **Konkani, Manipuri, and Nepali languages** to the** Eighth Schedule** of the Indian Constitution, recognizing them as **official languages of India.**
 
• The amendment was a significant step towards** linguistic inclusivity, acknowledging the cultural and linguistic diversity **of India and granting official status to these languages.
 
• The 71st Amendment highlighted the importance of **preserving and promoting** these languages, ensuring their** protection**, and **facilitating educational resources, official documentation, and communication** in these languages for their respective communities.
 
• The addition of **Konkani, Manipuri, and Nepali** languages to the Eighth Schedule aimed to provide representation and support to linguistic communities in **Goa, Manipur, and Sikkim, respectively.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****There are a total of 12 Schedules in the Indian Constitution.**

 
 

 
 
**Schedules**

 
 
 
**Features**

 
 
 

 
 
First Schedule

 
 
 
List of States & Union Territories

 
 
 

 
 
Second Schedule

 
 
 
Salary of President, Governors, Chief Judges, Judges of High Court and Supreme Court, Comptroller and Auditor General.

 
 
 

 
 
Third Schedule

 
 
 
Forms of Oaths and Affirmations

 
 
 

 
 
Fourth Schedule

 
 
 
Allocate seats for each state of India in Rajya Sabha

 
 
 

 
 
Fifth Schedule

 
 
 
Administration and control of scheduled areas and tribes.

 
 
 

 
 
Sixth Schedule

 
 
 
Provisions for the administration of Tribal Areas in Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram 

 
 
 

 
 
Seventh Schedule

 
 
 
Gives allocation of powers and functions between Unions & States. It contains 3 lists Union List, States, Concurrent List

 
 
 

 
 
Eighth Schedule

 
 
 
List of 22 languages of India recognized by the Constitution.

 
 
 

 
 
Ninth Schedule

 
 
 
It contains acts & orders related to land tenure, land tax, railways, and industries.

 
 
 

 
 
Tenth Schedule

 
 
 
It contains provisions for disqualification of grounds of defection.

 
 
 

 
 
Eleventh Schedule

 
 
 
It contains provisions of the Panchayati Raj.

 
 
 

 
 
Twelfth Schedule

 
 
 
It contains provisions of the Municipal Corporation.
